left.raw_text: 1. history of prior laser treatment or vitrectomy in the study eye;

right.raw_text: 2. history of thromboembolic event - including myocardial infarction or cerebral vascular accident;

left.raw_text: 3. major surgery within the prior 6 months or planned within the next 28 days;

right.raw_text: 4. history of glaucoma or ocular hypertension;

left.raw_text: 5. loss of vision as a result of other causes;
6. history of systemic corticosteroid therapy within the last 3 months;

right.raw_text: 7. severe systemic disease other than diabetes mellitus;

left.raw_text: 8. known coagulation abnormalities or current use of anticoagulative medication other than aspirin

right.raw_text: 9. any condition that could affect followup or documentation (including preretinal or vitreous hemorrhage).
